title: Scaling total life in a null-recurrent renewal process
exact_target: Can the length of the renewal interval containing a distant time be rescaled to a nonconstant limit in the infinite-mean case?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900002 (AMR-098-0002). CC BY 4.0.

Hermann Thorisson, \emph{Some Open Probability Problems}, author preprint; original Universidad de Buenos Aires copy preserved in Internet Archive capture of 27 March 2024, Section 1, renewal definitions, p. 1, and Problem 1.2, p. 2.
